investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC investigation per BOTM-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01: one unauthenticated GET to the venue's official_website (WebFetch/curl fallback), with at most one additional same-origin GET when official_programme_url was directly supplied as a candidate field. No browser, authentication, CAPTCHA bypass, or retry loop.

venue_reference: White Bear Theatre Pub — London (address text corrupted in source estate; treated as UNKNOWN, not invented)

identity.notes: Canonical URL, <title>, and meta description all match the venue name and self-describe it as White Bear Theatre; no cross-domain redirect occurred.

site_classification.platform: Server-rendered marketing/box-office site (single unauthenticated GET returned real body text).

probe_history.reason: A single unauthenticated GET to the official homepage returned <head> metadata that directly and unambiguously self-describes the venue's core identity as a fringe theatre, conclusively answering the music-relevance question without further escalation.

reasons: The venue's own meta description states: 'White Bear Theatre is an award fringe theatre founded in 1988 at the White Bear Pub in Kennington, London, by founder and Artistic Director Michael Kingsbury.' — the venue self-identifies as a fringe theatre.

The fetched page contains 645 occurrences of 'play' and 6 of 'fringe theatre' against zero occurrences of 'live music', 'gig', 'band', 'jazz', or 'cabaret' — real evidence that the primary programme is theatrical, not musical, and therefore fails BeatMapped's venue-level music gate.

evidence.description: Verbatim, byte-faithful <head> excerpt: <title>, meta description, and canonical link, self-describing the venue as an award fringe theatre.
evidence.method: curl -sS -L; descriptive User-Agent; single unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; no retry
